retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the local elections of 17 December 1989, for 305 municipal chambers and more than four thousand parishes. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the fifth local election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
